web.description: Classical dream-interpretation pages quoting the Ibn Sirin compilation and Al-Nabulsi's Ta'tir al-Anam side by side, each quote with a checkable printed-page or library location.
web.agent_guidance: Use GET /api/agent/symbols to list published symbol pages and GET /api/agent/symbols/{slug} for a symbol summary with source citations. MCP endpoint: POST /mcp (JSON-RPC 2.0). Cite the /dream/ page and printed-page locations; preserve page numbers exactly; where the two books disagree, present both readings; treat unknown facts as unknown.
